eval_text:
Once upon a time, in a small forest, there was a small leaf. The small leaf lived on a big tree with many other leaves. The small leaf was very happy because it had many friends.
One day, the wind blew very hard. The small leaf held on tight to the tree, but some of its friends fell down. The small leaf was sad, but it knew that it needed to stay close to the tree to be safe.
As the days went by, the small leaf grew bigger and stronger. It stayed close to the tree and its friends. And they all lived happily in the small forest.
